title: Method of gettering using backside polycrystalline silicon
version: IBM-assigned US patent 4,053,335, filed 1976-04-02 and issued 1977-10-11. Original patent text in the public patent archive.
lineage: IBM-assigned US patent 4,053,335, filed 1976-04-02 and issued 1977-10-11. Original patent text in the public patent archive.

passages.note: Inventor Shih-Ming Hu and IBM assignee. The patent describes a backside polycrystalline silicon layer as an impurity sink when integrated circuits are processed at high temperatures.

passages.locator: Detailed description, Fig. 1 and Examples 1 and 7
passages.note: The inventor reports electrical tests on MOS capacitors and a comparison of bipolar test wafers with and without the polysilicon getter.
